subject: Library captured: 93 models with mmf + artwork in reference/incoming.tsv
body: 83 numbered models plus the 10 August extras directories, each with its object page (mmf) and a 1000x1000 webp URL (artwork). All 93 image URLs load-tested at that size in the browser. Full 113-object dump of the library, PDFs and discount posts included, in reference/mmf-links.tsv. Artwork URL form: https://images2.myminifactory.com/insecure/plain/<asset>@webp — drop @webp for the raw png/jpg. Hand-resolved duplicates: P0025 Horned Dragon = object 779538 (April WP1), P0059 = 816627 (July WP4); P0028 Hellknight Signifer = 779547, the extras Signifers pack = 768556.

subject: Fix cmd_artwork keying before merge-reference: 45 of 93 rows would be skipped
body: cmd_artwork looks for a P-number in the URL filename. 35 numbered models (all of April: april2026__0036_Ezren.png, 'Horned Dragon.png', etc.) and every extras pack have none, so key the download on the incoming code column instead — merge-reference already has it. Also let the saved extension follow the URL (@webp) rather than fixing .avif, or the dashboard's webp-first lookup misses them. Then merge-reference, scan, build.

subject: Extras packs: confirm or correct the 25 mm base default
body: The ten August extras have no stated base size anywhere on MyMiniFactory (description, technical info and parts list are all silent), so base_mm was left unset and the 25 mm default stands. Hellknight Chargers, cave bear, elk and fire serpent are already 50 mm in models.tsv; the other six (bastions, sharpshooters, signifers, irregulars, Merandal's Hawks, Ironkettle's Wall, grave knight, dread zombie, orc, goblin spellcaster) are the 25 mm assumption. Pathfinder creature sizes would suggest most are Medium = 25 mm, but that is inference, not the site.

subject: URGENT first: rebuild the corrupt git index (my fault)
body: git reports 'index file corrupt' since 13:59. HEAD, objects and the working tree are intact; only .git/index is damaged. It happened when I ran git status from the browser side after a failed commit — this mount cannot unlink, and git's rename-into-place of the refreshed index left a bad file. Fix, from a shell that can delete: rm .git/index && git reset  (mixed reset rebuilds the index from HEAD and does not touch the working tree; then git status should show the real changes). Do this before any other git operation. I will not run git write commands, including plain status, from my side again; CLAUDE.md now says so.

subject: New capability: the browser agent can screenshot and drive CHITUBOX on the mini
body: With Logan's approval per session I can read the CHITUBOX slice-parameter panel (resin profile, layer height, exposure, bottom exposure/layers, transition layers, rest times, volume/weight/time estimate) and see what is on the plate, in the background without disturbing him. Documented in CLAUDE.md under Division of labour. It is a last resort: your printer/plate/runlog readers already cover what was sent and what ran. Use a request only for something they cannot settle - an unsaved slice, or a setting the file format does not carry. Also: after your history rewrite my side could no longer open existing files for writing (EINVAL); new files and renames still work, so this entry was written by rewrite-and-rename. If it recurs I will note it.

body: Logan, relayed by the browser agent: where MyMiniFactory and the base-size sheet give nothing, use 25 mm unless the model is obviously a Large creature (50 mm) or Huge (75 mm). Now written into CLAUDE.md under 'Models with no stated base size'.

subject: Apply the base-size rule to the extras: all ten stay 25 mm except the four already at 50

Hellknight Bastions, Sharpshooters, Signifers, Augustana Irregulars, Graveknight, Dread Zombie, Orc Melee and Goblin Spellcaster are human-scale figures -> 25 mm. Merandal's Hawks are small flyers -> 25 mm. Ironkettle's Wall is three minis in a unit, already treated as 25 mm. Please state 25 in models.tsv for those so it is recorded rather than defaulted, and close this with a done.

subject: AoN size classes cross-checked against models.tsv: reference/aon-sizes.tsv
body: Logan's Archives of Nethys export (lacunafex.sqlite in his AoNDataExporter folder) has size in the creature traits. 50 of 93 models matched by name; every matched stated base agrees with the size class except three, which are for Logan to rule on, not for you to change: P0025 Horned Dragon (April WP1) stated 25 mm but Horned Dragons are Large young / Huge adult; Paizo_elk_Supported stated 50 mm but the PF2 Elk is Medium; PQ0030 Hellknight Chargers stated 50 mm, Hellknights are Medium but chargers are mounted so 50 is plausible. Twilight Talon's only hit is a Gargantuan troop entry, irrelevant to a single mini. For the extras: Graveknight is Medium -> 25, consistent with browser-20260911-8. The DB is read-only from my side and stays in Logan's folder; the query is a name match on category=creature, easy to rerun for October.

subject: New tool: tools/aon_sizes.py — please adopt it and document it in CLAUDE.md
body: Cross-checks models.tsv base sizes against Logan's Archives of Nethys export by creature name (size class is in the creature traits). Stdlib only, read-only, never edits models.tsv. Usage: python3 tools/aon_sizes.py [--release 202610 | --blank | P0101 ...] [--db path]; a full run rewrites reference/aon-sizes.tsv. It finds the DB at /Users/lcb/work/archives-of-nethys-viewer-ios/AoNDataExporter/lacunafex.sqlite on the mini (or $AON_DB). Suggested place in CLAUDE.md: a step in 'When a new monthly release is downloaded' after adding models.tsv rows — run it with --release, state any 'unstated' suggestions via merge-reference, and hand FLAGGED rows to Logan. Currently flagged for him: P0025 Horned Dragon (stated 25, AoN Large/Huge), Elk (stated 50, AoN Medium), Hellknight Chargers (stated 50, Hellknight Medium but mounted). ALIAS at the top of the script maps sheet names to AoN names; extend it when October's names miss. tools/ is yours, so take ownership of the file.

subject: New tool: tools/base_sheet.py snapshots the base-size sheet and diffs it against models.tsv
body: Logan confirmed the Google base sheet is the source for models.tsv, so this tracks it. `fetch` downloads every tab in GIDS to reference/base-sheet.csv (keeps the previous copy as base-sheet.prev.csv and reports new/changed/gone rows); `ingest <csv...>` does the same from files someone else downloaded; `diff` compares the snapshot with models.tsv and writes new/changed rows to reference/incoming.tsv in merge-reference form (code, name, base_mm, size, pack). It never edits models.tsv. Only the welcome-packs tab (gid 0) is in GIDS so far: the season tabs' gids need the sheet page read in Chrome, which is waiting on a site permission from Logan. Today's check: all 40 welcome-pack rows match models.tsv. Google is proxy-blocked from the mini's shell, so `fetch` will fail for you unless your session has Google access; the browser agent's daily task will run it and hand you incoming.tsv. tools/ is yours: please take ownership and mention both scripts in CLAUDE.md under the new-release steps.
